description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Curfew Order under Section 16
categorisation: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance, which constitutes a legal/regulatory measure. It establishes a binding regulation (curfew) that restricts public movement in specified areas during designated hours, with enforcement authority granted to specific government officials. This falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves the implementation of statutory powers and creates legal obligations for citizens.
